en.headline: Receivers sell Shimao’s Tung Chung hotels for HK$2.7 billion
en.dek: The Sheraton and Four Points by Sheraton complex on Lantau, with 1,219 rooms, is sold to a buyer linked to Malaysian developer ParkCity.
body: Receivers of the Sheraton Hong Kong Tung Chung Hotel and the Four Points by Sheraton have agreed to sell the dual-branded complex for HK$2.7 billion, Shimao Group said in a filing to the Hong Kong stock exchange on Thursday.

The 1,219-room property on Lantau Island, described as the city’s third-largest hotel by room count, was seized by lenders earlier this year after the mainland developer failed to sell it for about US$570 million in late 2024.

The buyer is Oceanfront Hong Kong Limited, owned by investment vehicles associated with ParkCity Group, a Malaysian property developer. Directors of Oceanfront include Joseph Lau, chief executive of ParkCity, and Keoy Soo Lik.

AlixPartners, acting as receiver, and Marriott, which operates the hotels, said the sale followed a competitive tender that closed at the end of August. Completion is expected before the end of 2026, with proceeds to be used for debt repayment.

zh.headline: 世茂東涌喜來登酒店銀主盤以27億元出售
zh.dek: 大嶼山雙品牌酒店共1,219間客房，售予與馬來西亞發展商ParkCity有關的買家，預計年底前完成。
body: 世茂集團周四向香港交易所提交公告，指東涌喜來登酒店及福朋喜來登酒店的接管人已同意以27億港元出售該雙品牌酒店綜合體。
這座位於大嶼山、共有1,219間客房的物業，按客房數目計是本港第三大酒店。今年稍早被債權人接管，此前發展商在2024年底曾試圖以約5.7億美元出售但不果。
買家為Oceanfront Hong Kong Limited，由與馬來西亞地產發展商ParkCity Group有關的投資工具擁有。公司董事包括ParkCity行政總裁劉氏及具香港身份證的另一名人士。
接管人AlixPartners及營運商萬豪表示，出售是經過8月底截止的競標程序，過程競爭激烈。交易預計於2026年底前完成，所得款項將用於償還債務。
